image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a black assault rifle (resembling an AR-15/M4 platform) against a white background. The image shows the receiver, pistol grip, part of the handguard/barrel, and a sling. There is a visible optical sight on top.

artifact_observations.location: Sling attachment points and strap geometry
artifact_observations.reasoning: The black sling straps in the foreground appear to merge into the background or the gun body without clear physical attachment points (swivels). The geometry of the loops is slightly nonsensical.
The ribbed texture of the handguard becomes indistinct and slightly 'mushy' towards the right edge of the frame, lacking the sharp mechanical precision expected of machined metal.
The scope lacks distinct lens reflections or adjustment turrets, appearing as a simplified black blob rather than a complex mechanical assembly.
